name: Spicy Chicken & Chorizo Fajitas
steps: Chop the avocado into chunks and add into a bowl with the juice of the lime. Season with salt and pepper and mash everything together.
Chop the chorizo into 2-3cm bite sized chunk and add them to a large frying pan. Place over medium heat and fry until the fat renders out and they become slightly crispy.
Meanwhile, slice the peppers and onion. Thinly slice the chicken. Once the chorizo has gone crispy, stir the peppers and onion in. Cook, stirring, until softened, 4-6 mins.
Once the veggies have softened, add the chicken and fajita seasoning. Season with salt and stir fry until the chicken is cooked through, 4-6 mins. Taste and season with more salt, if needed.

Add a dollop of guac onto the tortilla, then layer the fajita mixture, soured cream and sprinkle with coriander on top. Fold in the sides, then roll up tightly into wraps. To seal, place back into the frying pan over medium heat, and cook, seam side down, until sealed. Wrap in baking paper or foil before serving.
